exposure: Continuous support by a midwife during childbirth
Fear of childbirth (FOC) status (severe FOC vs. no FOC)
outcome: Mode of delivery (induction of labor, cesarean section)
cohort: 14 women with severe FOC (index group) and 28 women without FOC (reference group) giving birth
finding: Women with severe FOC who received continuous support by a midwife during childbirth had a shorter duration of active labor compared to parous women without FOC, but there was no difference in cesarean section frequency between the two groups.
mod_finding: Women with severe FOC more often had an induction of labor.
